g.text: Simulator: register a dose once, whatever the retries
solid arrow: request or SQL · dashed: response
Retry after a lost answer: same key, same body
Rejected: a 4xx, counted and dropped by the simulator
Network error, 401, 429 or 5xx (503 while the marts are not built)

text.tspan: ROW EXCLUSIVE, read open G, INSERT
to 30 s; a 401 drops the token
fails when it is older than 30 s
